brief:
Israeli military forces conducted raids on non-governmental organizations in Ramallah, according to Al Jazeera English. The operations targeted multiple NGO offices in the Palestinian city, though specific details about the organizations affected and the stated purpose of the raids were not immediately available.

The raids add to a pattern of Israeli security operations in Palestinian areas of the West Bank, where tensions remain high over settlement expansion and military enforcement actions.
dek: Jerusalem Daily: Israeli forces raid NGOs in Ramallah…
title: Israeli forces raid NGOs in Ramallah
